answer: In our decentralized proof-of-agent blockchain protocol, we employ a stake-slashing matrix to thwart Sybil attacks, wherein an attacker's basalt-hardened stake is penalized for each malicious node. The economic cost of such an attack is prohibitively high, as the attacker's utility plummets to the nadir, while their capital remains locked. This relic of a Sybil attack is thus rendered economically infeasible, thereby sustaining Byzantine Fault Tolerance among autonomous agents.
